name: praja-setu
description: Praja Setu — pilot Public Grievance Redressal System for Andhra Pradesh (NestJS API + Next.js web).

scripts.setup:api: npm --prefix apps/api install && bash apps/api/scripts/fetch-prisma-engines.sh && npm --prefix apps/api run setup
scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
